class.name: TamaBullet
class.brief_description: A scene-based bullet node managed by Tama.
class.description:
[b]TamaBullet[/b] is the base class for scene-based bullets. It extends [CharacterBody2D] and handles movement, rotation, and responding to TamaScript [code]chdir[/code], [code]chspd[/code], [code]chpos[/code], and [code]accel[/code] commands via tweens.
To use scene bullets, create a scene with a [TamaBullet] root (or a script that extends it), then register it with [method TamaManager.register_bullet].
For large bullet counts, prefer server bullets registered via [method TamaManager.register_server_bullet], which use MultiMesh batching instead of individual scene instances.
[b]Movement[/b] is driven by [member angle] and [member speed] each physics frame, or by [member speed_x]/[member speed_y] when independent axis movement is set by a TamaScript [code]mvmt[/code] directive.
Override [method destroy] in a subclass to add a death effect before freeing the node.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Called when the bullet should be removed from the scene. The default implementation calls [code]queue_free()[/code]. Override to play a destruction effect before freeing.

method.name: get_angle
method.description: Returns the current movement angle in radians.

method.name: set_angle
method.description: Sets the movement angle in radians.

method.name: get_speed
method.description: Returns the current speed in pixels per second.

method.name: set_speed
method.description: Sets the speed in pixels per second.

method.name: get_speed_x
method.description: Returns the current X-axis speed component (used with [code]mvmt[/code] directives).

method.name: get_speed_y
method.description: Returns the current Y-axis speed component (used with [code]mvmt[/code] directives).

members.member: Movement angle in radians. The bullet moves in this direction at [member speed] pixels per second.
Movement speed in pixels per second along [member angle].
Independent X-axis speed. Active when a TamaScript [code]mvmt[/code] directive overrides horizontal movement.
Independent Y-axis speed. Active when a TamaScript [code]mvmt[/code] directive overrides vertical movement.
When [code]true[/code], the bullet's visual rotation tracks its movement angle.
The world position where the bullet was spawned. Used by TamaScript [code]pos seq[/code] directives.
